reviewContext.issueReference: No GitHub issue. User-reported bug from the ART art-remediate live run on 2026-11-11: relative agent-node workingDirectory 'tmp/art-remediate/active/src' failed with 'agent-gateway error -32602: cwd must be an absolute path'.
reviewContext.userProblem: An agent node with a relative workingDirectory, run via `riela workflow run --working-dir <root>`, passes the relative path unresolved to the local agent backend, which rejects it ('cwd must be an absolute path'). Command/container stdio executors resolve relative paths against the process cwd instead of the run workspace root, and execution records (resolvedBackendWorkingDirectory) have the same flaw.
requiredOutcomes: Relative node workingDirectory, command.workingDirectory and container.workingDirectory resolve to <fanoutWorkspaceRoot>/<rel> (lexically standardized) before local dispatch in DeterministicWorkflowRunner (AdapterExecutionInput and WorkflowStdioNodeExecutionInput sites).
Absolute values reach the backend byte-identical.
Execution records (backendWorkingDirectory) report the resolved absolute path via resolvedBackendWorkingDirectory using the same anchoredWorkingDirectory helper.
`riela package run` passes fanoutWorkspaceRoot: workingDirectoryURL so it gets the same root as workflow run (Step 5 finding NCR-R1).
Regression tests in Tests/RielaCoreTests/NodeWorkingDirectoryResolutionTests.swift cover relative, '..', absolute, nil, command inherit/explicit, container, placement passthrough and nil-root cases.
nonGoals: No edits under Sources/RielaAdapters, Sources/RielaCore/DistributedWorkerNodeExecutor.swift, Sources/RielaCLI/WorkflowStagedVerification.swift, or other RielaCLI files besides WorkflowPackageParityCommands.swift.
No new workspace-escape/policyBlocked check; do not reuse DistributedWorkerWorkspace.resolve locally.
No symlink resolution; lexical standardizedFileURL only.
Do not fill nil working directories; executors already fall back.
Do not change riela/command-result add-on workingDirectory config.
No further docs edits; design-docs/specs/design-workflow-json.md already holds the rule.
constraints: Work only in worktree /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela-worktrees/node-cwd; do not modify the main checkout or its .build.
Do not restart/kill/reconfigure RielaApp, modify ~/.riela/** or installed binaries; use temp dirs and fake backends in tests.
Keep absolute-path behavior and existing escape policies unchanged; additive and minimal.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D1: resolve once in DeterministicWorkflowRunner before local dispatch; adapters unchanged.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Adapters already handle absolute input correctly; one shared helper keeps backend cwd and execution records consistent.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D2: steps with placement are passed through unresolved.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Remote workers resolve relative paths against their own workspace via DistributedWorkerWorkspace.resolve; controller-absolute paths would break that mapping.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D3/D4: no new escape check; '..' is anchored and lexically standardized, symlinks not resolved.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Local runs have no escape check today; requirement says do not loosen or tighten existing policy.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D5: resolvedBackendWorkingDirectory uses anchoredWorkingDirectory for non-nil configured values.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Execution records must report the resolved absolute path that matches the dispatched cwd.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D6: nil fanoutWorkspaceRoot keeps legacy pass-through.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Library/test callers without a root keep current behavior; existing DeterministicWorkflowRunnerBackendEventTests relative case stays green unmodified.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-11 (Step 5 NCR-R1): add WorkflowPackageParityCommands.swift to writePaths to pass fanoutWorkspaceRoot for `riela package run`; WorkflowStagedVerification.swift stays nil.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: package run was the only production entry point without a workspace root; staged verification is scenario-only.

intentionalTradeoffs: Fanout changeTracking becomes allowed under `riela package run`, matching `workflow run`.
Workflows relying on a relative path resolving against a different process cwd now resolve against the workspace root.
supportedEdgeCases: Relative path with '..' (anchored and standardized, not rejected).
Nil workingDirectory (unchanged; record falls back to workspace root).
Command node inheriting node workingDirectory; explicit command.workingDirectory; container.workingDirectory.
Runner with nil workspace root (legacy pass-through).

acceptanceCriteria: An agent node with workingDirectory 'sub/dir' run with workspace root /X reaches its backend with cwd /X/sub/dir (recording adapter test).
A command node with a relative workingDirectory runs in <working-dir>/<rel>.
Absolute workingDirectory values are unchanged; execution records report the resolved absolute path.
`rg -n 'func anchoredWorkingDirectory' Sources/RielaCore` has 1 hit; `rg -n 'anchoringLocalWorkingDirectories' Sources/RielaCore/DeterministicWorkflowRunner.swift` has 2 hits.

`git diff --name-only 3a9c1dad -- Sources/RielaAdapters Sources/RielaCLI Sources/RielaCore/DistributedWorkerNodeExecutor.swift` lists exactly Sources/RielaCLI/WorkflowPackageParityCommands.swift with one added argument line.
swift build and focused swift test filters pass; swiftlint reports no new violations on changed files; progress log records each case, log paths and exit codes.
